quote: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) is an effective solution to solve the incompletion problem. KGE aims to learn the low-dimensional vectors (embeddings) for entities and relations based on the observed triples in KGs.
We conduct experiments for KGE on two widely used public benchmark datasets ...
To evaluate our method, three metrics are used, including Mean Rank (MR), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), and Hit@10 (e.g. the accuracy in top 10 predictions).
